description: Preserved on the base; former registration F-THAO. Being worked on by a volunteer team of base personnel (Aero Reflect Technical) in 2026. Mirage IV disposal list compiled by 'BEN' on the Delta Reflex forum (December 2023), which tracks all 62 Mirage IVA/IVP airframes individually. Reported by the French preservation blog foxalphazoulou.overblog.com in its monthly 'Infos patrimoine' updates (2026).
Preserved on the base; former registration F-THCH. Mirage IV disposal list compiled by 'BEN' on the Delta Reflex forum (December 2023), which tracks all 62 Mirage IVA/IVP airframes individually.

Stored at Saint-Dizier since 2023 pending restoration for the Memorial Charles de Gaulle at Colombey-les-Deux-Eglises; not on public view. Mirage IV disposal list compiled by 'BEN' on the Delta Reflex forum (December 2023), which tracks all 62 Mirage IVA/IVP airframes individually.

Restored by a volunteer team of base personnel in Gulf War camouflage and shown at the base open days of 12-13 September 2026. Reported as intended for the National Museum of the USAF at Dayton, so its stay at Saint-Dizier may be temporary. Reported by the French preservation blog foxalphazoulou.overblog.com in its monthly 'Infos patrimoine' updates (2026).
